description: Three leaf and tree rules over the same chunks (RFC 07 sections 7.2-7.5, F16): the chunks are the 720-byte cut of the UTF-8 input (section 3); shdccp2 is Owl's growBiochain output, bioseed1 the BIOSEED/1 rule of BioChain-AI protocol/codex_engine.py, rfc6962 the RFC 6962 tree with the raw chunks as entries. The three roots always differ, so a root read under the wrong rule never verifies; records carry no rule tag, so a verifier dispatches on streamVersion.

basis: RFC 07 section 7.4: BIOSEED/1 leaves and root
RFC 6962 section 2.1: the Merkle Tree Hash
